Name: One tile high Budget TV
Author: Aimon111
Description:
This mod makes Budged TV furniture piece one tile high (like other TV's in game). Compatible with any recolor and other furniture mods.

I was always annoyed of this 2 tile high Budged TV, It's just don't match other furniture and takes more space to place. So I decided to fix it.

Note that there's one bug I can't fix because it's hardcoded into the game: as you play the TV, the screenplay plays at the default position and does not implement the one tile TV budget. So the screen just off plays one tile below the TV frame. Thanks to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108412458]NinTheCactus69[/url] for telling about this bug.

To fix this bug you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20955/]One-Tile Budget TV Screen Fix[/url] mod made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26190569]Khitiara[/url]!

[s]If you don't like this bug, you can use[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10213?tab=description] Furniture Adjustments[/url] mod instead of mine.[/s]
